sections.chapter_title: Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)
sections.text_helper: Section 7.5 "RISAF registers" in chapter 7 (Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 265.
sections.section_content:
The registers are accessible through the interface of the RISAF. Only word (32-bit)
accesses are supported.
